changes: First release. Light pad taps, which the panel sends without a strike, play as soft hits at velocity 8 (GLOBAL row LIGHT TAPS, project storage field light_taps_enabled). Three jsr sites over the panel driver's pad and key event posts and its ms tick (0x4008232c, 0x40082492, 0x40081944); a held pad's key repeats are ignored, and a light-tapped pad posts its own pad release when let go.
stockPolicy: No firmware or stock-derived code/tables are present. Addresses, lengths and SHA-256 guards are metadata; exported instructions and sections are authored module code. Local materialized recipes and firmware are never committed.
